content: निर्हारः .²1 Taking away, removing, removal. .²2 Drawing out, extracting. .²3 Rooting up, destruction; कर्मणा कर्मनिर्हारो न ह्यात्यन्तिक इष्यते <ls>Bhāg. 6. 1. 11</ls>. .²4 Carrying out a dead body to be burnt; एवं विलपतीनां वै परिगृह्य मृतं पतिम् . अनिच्छतीनां निर्हारमर्कोऽस्तं संन्यवर्तत .. <ls>Bhāg. 7. 2. 35</ls>. .²5 Accumulation of a private store of wealth, private hoard; न निर्हारं स्त्रियः कुर्युः कुटुम्बाद्बहुमध्यगात् <ls>Ms. 9. 199</ls>. .²6 Evacuation of the natural excrements of the body (<ab>opp.</ab> आहार). .²7 Putting forth or out. .²8 Setting aside, excluding, leaving. .²9 Deduction. .²10 Diffusive fragrance.
